title: What's really under Yellowstone (2025 studies) #Shorts
description:
Two 2025 studies in Nature show the magma under Yellowstone is only about 9 to 15 percent melted, "like a sponge with a little liquid in its holes." One scientist called the venting "steady breathing."

▶ Full documentary (Part 1, What's Really Under Yellowstone): https://youtu.be/-vkXqMrSljM
